summary.text: Abigail Wolters is the Republican candidate for Minnesota State Senate District 60 in the November 3, 2026 general election, in which she faces incumbent Doron Clark (D).

paragraphs.text: Abigail Wolters won the Republican primary in the January 2025 special election for Minnesota State Senate District 60, defeating Christopher Robin Zimmerman, 153 votes to 59.
In the special general election on January 28, 2025, Doron Clark defeated Wolters, 7,783 votes to 746.
Wolters also appeared on the November 2024 general election ballot for Minnesota House of Representatives District 60B, which incumbent Mohamud Noor won.
